home.hero.title: Bring trusted produce to market.
home.hero.copy: Kisaan Setu connects farmers and wholesale buyers directly, helping every harvest move with clear pricing, verified profiles, and fair negotiation.

home.steps.copy: Crops move from farm gate to buyer with transparent digital negotiation and verified sourcing.

home.steps.step3.copy: Offers, counteroffers, and agreement proceed in the platform before pickup.
